glossary.ndvi.label: NDVI
glossary.ndvi.title: Vegetation greenness (e.g., NDVI)
glossary.ndvi.definition: A satellite score from 0 to 1; higher means more living plants.
glossary.et.label: ET
glossary.et.title: Evapotranspiration (ET)
glossary.et.definition: Water leaving the field through soil evaporation and plant breathing.
glossary.et0.label: ET0
glossary.et0.title: Reference ET (ET0)
glossary.et0.definition: How much water a standard grass field would use in today's weather.
glossary.kc.label: Kc
glossary.kc.title: Crop coefficient (Kc)
glossary.kc.definition: How thirsty a crop is compared with standard grass, by growth stage.
glossary.soilMoistureAnomaly.label: Soil moisture anomaly
glossary.soilMoistureAnomaly.title: Soil moisture anomaly
glossary.soilMoistureAnomaly.definition: How much wetter or drier the soil is than normal for that date.
glossary.waterBalance.label: Water balance
glossary.waterBalance.title: Water balance
glossary.waterBalance.definition: Rain and stored soil water minus what the crop needs.
glossary.frostRisk.label: Frost risk
glossary.frostRisk.title: Frost risk
glossary.frostRisk.definition: Chance of temperatures low enough to damage a crop at a sensitive stage.
glossary.fallow.label: Fallow
glossary.fallow.title: Fallow
glossary.fallow.definition: A season when the field is left unplanted.
glossary.seasonReplay.label: Season Replay
glossary.seasonReplay.title: Season Replay
glossary.seasonReplay.definition: Testing a rotation against real past weather to see how it would have performed.
glossary.ssp.label: SSP
glossary.ssp.title: Emissions scenario (SSP)
glossary.ssp.definition: A standard climate-future storyline (low, middle or high emissions).
glossary.managementZone.label: Management zone
glossary.managementZone.title: Management zone
glossary.managementZone.definition: A part of a field that behaves consistently differently from the rest.
glossary.groundTruth.label: Ground truth
glossary.groundTruth.title: Ground truth
glossary.groundTruth.definition: Independently recorded facts (e.g., official crop maps) used to check ITZA's estimates.
glossary.informationNeed.label: Information need
glossary.informationNeed.title: Information need
glossary.informationNeed.definition: A kind of data the product requires (e.g., daily rainfall), independent of which dataset provides it.
glossary.genUi.label: Generative interface
glossary.genUi.title: Generative interface (GenUI)
glossary.genUi.definition: An assistant that answers by assembling interactive screens (charts, cards, forms) from approved building blocks, instead of replying with text only.
